BL-1780 — A front-desk supervisor never signals a healthy bridge that serves a different project root - BL-789's adopt-or-free frees it today (kill -TERM then -KILL), which takes down another swarm's live front desk whenever two roots resolve one bridge port - it leaves it running, starts no bridge of its own and logs the port and the other root; an unhealthy bridge and a non-bridge listener are still freed
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A plain approve, with no choice posed. FIRM: when a healthy bridge serving a different project root holds this supervisor's bridge port, the supervisor sends it no signal, starts no bridge of its own, and logs one line naming the port and that root. FIRM: BL-789's other cases are unchanged: our own…
BL-1780 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1780" (or "reject BL-1780 <reason>") to act.
